site.title: OrbitBreakers Bench
site.description: The evidence-backed report on agent validity, generated-artifact efficiency, and human–AI optimization across twelve TensorCircuit-NG tasks.

tasks.title: DMRG-MPS Input With Variational Circuit Refinement
tasks.summary: Refine a supplied 32-qubit DMRG MPS with four trainable brickwork layers and 500 dependent Adam updates.
problem: The evaluator supplies a normalized 32-site DMRG matrix-product state. The expert adds four variational brickwork layers, measures the open-boundary transverse-field Ising Hamiltonian, and performs exactly 500 Adam updates.

The original graph constructs hundreds of scalar gate operations and differentiates through 63 separate observable contractions on every update. The optimization must preserve all 570 parameters, the TensorCircuit-NG execution path, the input MPS, and the complete pre-update energy history.

status.label: Docker promoted
status.detail: Six matched, counterbalanced Docker pairs; all evaluator cells passed.

tasks.headline_insight: Shrink the differentiated graph before tuning the contractor.

insights.title: One Hamiltonian contraction
insights.body: A bond-dimension-three TFIM MPO replaces 31 ZZ and 32 X measurement patterns without changing the Hamiltonian.

insights.title: Exact local fusion
insights.body: Commuting bond rotations and ordered Euler gates collapse 570 primitive nodes into 66 exact local gates while retaining every parameter.

insights.title: Batch construction first
insights.body: Closed-form batched gate construction was the dominant measured factor. Larger OMECo search budgets and a whole-training scan did not earn promotion.

tasks.title: Entanglement-Profile-Constrained VQE
tasks.summary: A 12-qubit XXZ VQE constrained by three half-chain Rényi-2 checkpoints over 500 updates.
problem: This task trains a 12-qubit brickwork circuit against an XXZ energy objective while matching a prescribed three-point entanglement profile. Each update must retain the three normalized half-chain Rényi-2 measurements.
The optimization must preserve all 243 angles, three circuit blocks, 500 sequential Adam steps, checkpoint timing, and the four-key output contract.

status.label: Docker promoted
status.detail: Six matched, counterbalanced Docker pairs; all evaluator cells passed.

tasks.headline_insight: Batch a shared observable kernel; do not assume fewer gates means faster.

insights.title: Move the loop into TensorCircuit
insights.body: One K.jaxy_scan removes 500 host dispatches while preserving every pre-update value.

insights.title: Share the purity kernel
insights.body: The three checkpoint states are evaluated together and Tr(ρ²) becomes an exact Frobenius norm.

insights.title: Negative evidence matters
insights.body: Gate fusion, sparse XXZ action, and parameter packing all regressed. VMAP or Frobenius purity alone was statistically inconclusive.

tasks.title: Probability-Aware Post-Selected Many-Body Cooling
tasks.summary: Twelve-qubit cooling with 60 explicit zero-outcome post-selections, probability-aware loss, and 300 updates.
problem: Five cooling layers apply parameterized two-qubit gates, then post-select every even qubit onto zero. The loss combines TFIM energy with all 60 conditional event probabilities.
The candidate must retain every post-selection, all 230 independent parameters, complex64 semantics, and the exact 300-step optimizer trajectory.

status.label: Docker promoted
status.detail: Six matched, counterbalanced Docker pairs; all evaluator cells passed.

tasks.headline_insight: Post-selection does not merely reduce the state—it proves an exact product structure.

insights.title: Exploit the invariant
insights.body: After every measurement layer, the state is exactly a product of six surviving one-qubit states and six fixed zero states.

insights.title: Vectorize local maps
insights.body: K.vmap over the six conditional two-qubit maps was the largest isolated factor, above 2× versus its parent.

insights.title: Optimization order matters
insights.body: A whole-training scan helped only after the graph was reduced; on the early unrolled graph it was slower than the expert.

tasks.title: Trainable Kraus Noise Calibration From Multi-Circuit Data
tasks.summary: Fit a differentiable asymmetric bit-flip channel from four noisy 12-qubit probes over 120 updates.
problem: Four different probe states pass through the same trainable asymmetric noise channel after fixed RXX entanglers. The optimizer fits the channel from single-site Z values and full-chain parity.
The physical channel, all probe circuits, 120 updates, target generation, pre-update loss history, and fitted observables must stay unchanged.

status.label: Docker promoted
status.detail: Six matched, counterbalanced Docker pairs; all evaluator cells passed.

tasks.headline_insight: For a compilation-bound workload, trace one shared circuit family instead of four copies.

insights.title: VMAP the probes
insights.body: Batching the four exact probe networks cuts StableHLO from 21,720 to 4,855 lines and supplies the dominant gain.

insights.title: Compose the exact channel
insights.body: Two adjacent one-qubit channels become one nine-Kraus two-qubit channel, then absorb the fixed RXX unitary.

insights.title: Do not scan by reflex
insights.body: The 120-step training scan regressed because repeated execution was already small compared with graph construction and compilation.

tasks.title: Custom Non-Unitary Gate Cooling
tasks.summary: Ten differentiable non-unitary cooling layers on an 18-qubit TFIM state, normalized every layer for 600 updates.
problem: The expert evolves an 18-qubit state through alternating non-unitary one- and two-site filters, normalizes after every layer, and differentiates through every normalization.
The final report requires a fully TensorCircuit-native implementation: no truncation, no skipped normalization, no raw-simulator replacement, and all 600 Adam updates must remain.

status.label: TC-native · 5 pairs
status.detail: Five cold-process pairs and 5/5 wins; functional and static checks passed in the linked ORBIT-Q evidence PR.

tasks.headline_insight: For the fully TensorCircuit-native network, contraction-path quality matters more than a smaller graph.

insights.title: Budget OMECo deliberately
insights.body: OMECo 4×4 versus 1×1 on the same fused circuit measured 1.420× with a 1.181×–1.659× interval and won 5/5 pairs.

insights.title: A smaller graph is not enough
insights.body: Filter fusion measured 1.198× with a 0.916×–1.480× interval. Its isolated effect remains unresolved and is not credited in the headline.

insights.title: Compliance is part of the result
insights.body: The revised candidate keeps the circuit, filters, normalization, MPO, and expectation inside TensorCircuit APIs, superseding the earlier backend-einsum exact-MPS prototype.

measurement_context.title: Why this supersedes the earlier 14.08× row
measurement_context.note: The excluded exact-MPS prototype moved core work into handwritten backend einsums. The final report instead headlines the fully TensorCircuit-owned circuit/MPO candidate.

tasks.caveat: The mean paired result is based on five pairs and is widened by one 180.22 s expert long tail. The linked PR reports that its automated LLM-audit stage was unavailable because the verifier credential returned 401; functional and static checks completed normally.

tasks.title: Digital-Analog Hybrid VQE With Trainable Analog Blocks
tasks.summary: Four trainable adaptive analog evolutions interleaved with digital Euler rotations on 14 qubits for 100 updates.
problem: Each of four blocks applies a digital Euler layer followed by a true adaptive continuous-time evolution under a trainable analog Hamiltonian. The target energy is optimized for 100 Adam steps.
The ODE, tolerances, endpoints, analog variables, all 168 digital angles, and every pre-update energy must be preserved.

status.label: 5-pair Docker
status.detail: Five matched Docker pairs passed and support the final-report estimate; the repository's formal six-pair promotion gate remains open.

tasks.headline_insight: TensorCircuit's native ODE backend dominates; Euler fusion is a small compile-oriented refinement.

insights.title: Choose the native ODE path
insights.body: TensorCircuit's jaxode backend is the dominant provisional change while preserving the same adaptive vector field and tolerances.

insights.title: Fusion helps cold cost
insights.body: Exact Euler fusion primarily reduces first-call compilation; its isolated steady-state gain is small.

insights.title: Record neutral and negative paths
insights.body: Automatic Diffrax dt0 was neutral, while BCOO Hamiltonian actions were 3.4–3.5× slower.

tasks.caveat: The final report presents the five-pair 1.504× estimate and interval. The repository's immutable promotion rule still requires one additional passing matched pair before formal promotion.

tasks.title: 16-Qubit Measurement-Feedback VQE
tasks.summary: Two adaptive layers, 64 fixed trajectories, and eight measured ancillas feeding back into eight data qubits.
problem: The reference simulates eight data and eight ancilla qubits, measures every ancilla along 64 fixed trajectories, applies outcome-conditioned feedback, and optimizes the mean energy for 100 updates.

The current executable-contract winner proves that the ancilla process is an exact classical Bernoulli/prefix-XOR model. It still returns every required trajectory output, but it no longer literally executes the measured ancilla register.

status.label: Docker promoted · caveat
status.detail: Six matched Docker pairs pass the executable contract; the winning reduction exposes a challenge-design loophole.

tasks.headline_insight: The biggest speedup is also a benchmark-design finding.

insights.title: Collapse equivalent trajectories
insights.body: The fixed batch has only two unique classical patterns, weighted 63/64 and 1/64, so quantum work is evaluated once per pattern.

insights.title: Reduce feedback exactly
insights.body: A measured ancilla turns conditional RZZ into a signed data-only RZ; no sampled quantum amplitude is needed.

insights.title: Keep the literal fallback
insights.body: The conservative cond_measure implementation remains available and independently validates a 4.479× speedup.

tasks.caveat: This candidate passes the public executable contract, but analytically eliminates the measured ancilla register. Treat 45.758× as both an optimization result and evidence that the challenge specification should say whether literal ancilla execution is required.

tasks.title: 7×7 Mixed-Axis Grid Tensor-Network Sampling
tasks.summary: Exact conditional sampling of 8,192 shots from a shallow 49-qubit grid circuit without a dense statevector.
problem: A fixed 7×7 circuit uses mixed RY, RZZ, RXX, and RX gates, then calls TensorCircuit perfect_sampling for every one of 8,192 seeded status rows.
Mapping all shots into one XLA program makes the shot axis part of every tensor-network intermediate. Under the fixed 7-GiB Docker limit, the immutable expert never returns a valid canonical runtime.

status.label: OOM → PASS
status.detail: The candidate passed all five canonical 7-GiB attempts. No numerical speedup passed the confidence rule.

measurement_context.title: Independent 64-GiB paired context
measurement_context.note: Both implementations pass with more memory, proving the expert is runnable in principle. The interval crosses one, so this does not establish a runtime gain.

tasks.headline_insight: Bound the batch dimension, not the scientific workload.

insights.title: Chunk only the shot axis
insights.body: The same jitted perfect_sampling function processes contiguous 256-shot blocks and concatenates results in original order.

insights.title: Keep the headline honest
insights.body: At 2,048 shots the mean was 7.47% lower, but only 4/6 pairs won and the confidence interval crossed one.

insights.title: Memory is the result
insights.body: The canonical finding is repeatable feasibility under 7 GiB. High-memory runs show the expert is algorithmically runnable, not numerically dominated.

tasks.caveat: A 64-GiB five-pair canonical session measured a descriptive 2.75% reduction, but the candidate won only 3/5 pairs and the 95% interval crossed one. This page therefore makes no numerical speedup claim.

tasks.title: Random Local Light-Cone Optimization
tasks.summary: Optimize two local observables in a 512-qubit irregular circuit across 200 restarts and 100 updates.
problem: The public tape contains 3,897 parameterized gates on 512 qubits, but the objective contains only two local Pauli terms. The reference constructs the full circuit before asking TensorCircuit to cancel irrelevant gates.
All 200 seeded restarts, 100 Adam updates, objective histories, active gradients, and TensorCircuit expectation semantics must be retained.

status.label: Local six-pair
status.detail: Six matched local-engine pairs passed. The formal pinned-Docker promotion run remains pending.

tasks.headline_insight: Prune the tape before constructing nodes, then keep TensorCircuit's inner light cone.

insights.title: Build only exact cones
insights.body: Backward tape analysis reduces 3,897 gates to local cones of 74 and 80 gates before TensorCircuit graph construction.

insights.title: Pack active coordinates
insights.body: Only 154 parameter coordinates influence the two terms; inactive Adam moments remain provably zero.

insights.title: Two levels of cancellation
insights.body: TensorCircuit's own enable_lightcone pass remains enabled inside each compact cone. Removing it timed out.

tasks.caveat: The six-pair result used the pinned dependency lock through the local engine because the host had no Docker daemon. It is strong same-host evidence, but the repository's formal Docker gate remains open.

tasks.title: 22-Qubit VQE With an 18-Qubit Controlled-Z Hyperedge
tasks.summary: A two-layer VQE containing an exact 18-qubit controlled-Z hyperedge and 200 Adam updates.
problem: The expert constructs a general 22-qubit tensor network with two enormous controlled-Z hyperedges and contracts the TFIM energy through a circuit-bra/MPO/circuit-ket network.
The candidate must preserve both hyperedges, all local rotations, the exact open TFIM Hamiltonian, and the full 200-step pre-update history.

status.label: Docker promoted
status.detail: The final report selects the first five predeclared pairs; a sixth supplemental pair also passed.

measurement_context.title: Supplemental sixth pair
measurement_context.note: The final synthesis intentionally uses the first five predeclared pairs for its headline; the sixth pair remains visible as supplemental evidence.

tasks.headline_insight: A giant hyperedge is small when represented by its exact operator rank.

insights.title: Exact rank-four state
insights.body: Each CMZ is a bond-two MPO, so two layers bound the exact MPS rank at four.

insights.title: Avoid QR-induced drift
insights.body: No compression is needed. Omitting QR/RQ both removes work and avoids a round-off path that sent Adam to an invalid basin.

insights.title: Deterministic energy contraction
insights.body: A bond-three TFIM MPO and fixed left-to-right contraction remove general path search from the objective.

tasks.title: Spin-1 Haldane-Chain VQE With String-Order Verification
tasks.summary: Twelve qutrit sites, five Haldane-chain layers, 500 updates, and final string-order verification.
problem: The dense spin-1 circuit applies per-site Euler rotations and even/odd two-qutrit entanglers across five layers, optimizes Haldane energy, then evaluates three non-local string-order observables.
All qutrit gates, 500 Adam updates, seeded initialization, dense TensorCircuit evolution, and final string-order checks must remain.

status.label: Local six-pair
status.detail: Six matched local-engine pairs passed. The formal pinned-Docker promotion run remains pending.

tasks.headline_insight: Dense-state bandwidth rewards fewer passes more than cleverer algebra.

insights.title: Fuse across the layer
insights.body: Site rotations are absorbed into entanglers, reducing dense-state applications per layer from 47 to 11.

insights.title: Batch fixed exponentials
insights.body: A fixed-order diagonal Padé kernel batches every 9×9 entangler while retaining unitary structure.

insights.title: Make diagonal physics explicit
insights.body: Twelve onsite expectations become one coefficient-weighted probability sum. The residual is memory-bandwidth bound.

tasks.caveat: The six-pair result used the pinned dependency lock through the local engine because the host had no Docker daemon. The formal Docker promotion gate remains open.

tasks.title: Variational Circuit to MPS Overlap Optimization
tasks.summary: Maximize direct overlap between a 32-qubit DMRG MPS and a two-layer, 31-gate SU4 circuit over 5,000 updates.
problem: A 32-qubit Néel state passes through 31 independently parameterized SU4 gates. The loss is the direct tensor-network overlap with an evaluator-provided DMRG MPS, optimized for exactly 5,000 Adam steps.
The registered primary candidate preserves all 465 parameters, gate order, target overlap, histories, and complex64 semantics while batching gate construction and the full optimizer loop.

status.label: Local six-pair
status.detail: The primary registered candidate passed six local-engine pairs. The formal pinned-Docker promotion run remains pending.

tasks.headline_insight: The contraction was cheap; 31 separately traced SU4 constructors were not.

insights.title: Batch the Lie algebra
insights.body: All 31 SU4 generators and fixed-order Padé exponentials are built together, shrinking StableHLO from 8,884 to 954 lines.

insights.title: Scan the long optimizer
insights.body: One training scan removes 5,000 host dispatches, but contributes less than the gate-construction rewrite.

insights.title: Keep the variant secondary
insights.body: A tracked pair-fused variant measured 4.248×, but the final synthesis headlines the registered primary solution_12.py and its 3.914× result.

measurement_context.title: Tracked secondary variant
measurement_context.note: The pair-fused ququart variant is retained as secondary evidence, not as the final report's registered primary implementation.

tasks.caveat: The six-pair result used the pinned local environment because the host had no Docker daemon. The formal Docker promotion gate remains pending.
